description: This file is a shell script that serves as an SSH_ASKPASS handler, implemented using Tcl/Tk for GUI prompts. It prompts the user for passphrases or yes/no confirmations within a GUI dialog, facilitating automation in git operations that require user input.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Sets the return code to 255 and terminates the prompt without accepting input.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Validates user input if required, handles platform-specific encoding, outputs the answer, and exits with the appropriate return code.
